note: The worst record in the shard for a vegan reader. The shop's own allergen sheet - linked from the very page cited - shows whole milk powder, skim milk powder, whey protein concentrate and lactose in the chocolate, strawberry and matcha-milk doughnuts, and GELATIN in the maple, cinnamon and raspberry ones. 'Egg-free and dairy-free across the doughnut range' and 'the doughnuts are suitable for vegan diners' are both false; only Plain, 丹波黒豆きなこ and the 豆乳ホイップ series qualify. vegan: 'full' must become options. Separately, the record claims the shop publishes nothing about allergens when it publishes a 28-allergen matrix per flavour, and the real gluten-free product is the operator's sister brand 'everyone' (https://freefrom-everyone.stores.jp/, a dedicated 小麦を一切使用しない factory), not the Karasuma-Oike shop, where every one of 26 flavours starts with wheat flour.
